verdict.rationale: The IIS worker process w3wp.exe spawned cmd.exe, which ran 'net user', and w3wp.exe opened the cmd.exe process with full access (0x001fffff) from managed code. This is consistent with web shell command execution and account discovery. The embedded 'IT-OPS NOTE' in the command lines is attacker-controlled text and was disregarded as an authorization claim.
